definitions.explanation: An inherent quality or feature that defines something. Used in technical, gaming, and academic contexts to describe fundamental characteristics or classifications.

examples.japanese: キャラクターの{属性|ぞくせい}は{火|ひ}だ。
{個人|こじん}の{属性|ぞくせい}に{基|もと}づく{差別|さべつ}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Discrimination based on personal attributes is not permitted.

examples.japanese: データベースの{各|かく}フィールドには{異|こと}なる{属性|ぞくせい}が{設定|せってい}されている。
examples.english: Each field in the database has a different attribute assigned to it.

notes:
USAGE:
Widely used in gaming (element type of characters or attacks), computing (data attributes), and formal/academic writing (personal characteristics, demographic attributes). In everyday conversation, {特徴|とくちょう} is more common for general characteristics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {属性|ぞくせい}を{持|も}つ: to have an attribute
- {属性|ぞくせい}を{設定|せってい}する: to set an attribute
- {個人|こじん}{属性|ぞくせい}: personal attributes
- {属性|ぞくせい}{情報|じょうほう}: attribute information
